name: hud-overview
what: The whole game screen in a skirmish (4 Peaks), a peasant selected: top bar, both bottom panels, minimap, build menu

game.note: A skirmish a few minutes in, a peasant selected so the build menu and the selection panel show; clouds off; daylight

name: hud-top-bar
what: The top bar across the width: the five buttons at the left, the colour banner, population, food, wood, gold and the food bar at the right; the speed line under it

game.note: Any skirmish with farms, so the food bar shows; crop to the top 110 pixels

name: hud-selection-panel-soldier
what: The lower left panel with a soldier selected: turning portrait, hit points, name and kills, experience arc, shield and sword rows, command buttons on the rim

game.note: A named soldier with some experience and kills (a hero if possible); enhanced graphics on for the portrait

name: hud-selection-panel-peasant
what: The lower left panel with a peasant carrying wood: food, wood, gold and stone rows

game.note: A peasant on its way back from chopping, carrying wood

name: hud-knuckle-buttons
what: The command buttons round the rim of the selection panel, one lit under the mouse

game.note: Several soldiers selected; mouse over one command button so its tooltip shows

name: hud-build-menu
what: The build menu at the upper left with its three tabs, the Economic tab open

game.note: A peasant selected; Economic tab (benchmark buildTab ECONOMIC)

name: hud-train-queue
what: A building selected: the train column with a count and the red progress bar, the research column beside it

game.note: A barracks with three or more units queued, one in progress

name: hud-formation-buttons
what: The round formation pad in the selection panel's window (Column, Line, Wedge, Orb quarters), Line pressed in

game.note: A Line formation of the player's selected; crop to the lower left panel

name: hud-minimap
what: The minimap panel: the map with dots, the white camera arrow, the four arc buttons (some green-rimmed), an alert dot or circle

game.note: Mid-game with fog of war on; an attack alert or a ping visible if possible

name: hud-peasant-activity
what: All five peasant activity tubes above the minimap, with counts and red bars

game.note: Peasant activity open on all five tubes (benchmark peasantActivity 1), peasants at several jobs

name: hud-chat
what: Chat lines at the left with the Say: line open

game.note: A multiplayer game with two or three chat messages, the chat key pressed

name: hud-text-window
what: A tutorial's text window in the gold frame, with page number and Back/Next buttons

game.note: Interactive Tutorial, the camera step window (several pages)

name: hud-objectives
what: The mission objectives window at the upper right, active and greyed entries

game.note: Interactive Tutorial with objectives shown, O pressed

name: hud-ai-message
what: An AI General's message window with the portrait and the coloured name

game.note: A skirmish against an AI General that has just sent a message (the script chat can trigger one)

name: hud-diplomacy
what: The Diplomacy window: rows of players with status buttons, one Accept offer blinking

game.note: Skirmish with Allow Diplomacy on, an AI having offered an alliance (benchmark diplomacyWindow [frame, 1])
game.todo: scripted run gave an empty shot (diplomacy off in a default skirmish; stampdown preview not drawn at the mouse) - needs its own set-up

name: hud-global-diplomacy
what: The Global Diplomacy report for four players

game.note: Four players, the player owning a Tavern (benchmark diplomacyWindow [frame, 2])
game.todo: scripted run gave an empty shot (diplomacy off in a default skirmish; stampdown preview not drawn at the mouse) - needs its own set-up

name: hud-tributes
what: The Tributes window with some gold set aside for one player

game.note: The player owning a Trading Post, diplomacy allowed (benchmark diplomacyWindow [frame, 3])
game.todo: scripted run gave an empty shot (diplomacy off in a default skirmish; stampdown preview not drawn at the mouse) - needs its own set-up

name: hud-statistics
what: The statistics window (F6): the table and the gold graph

game.note: A replay or a long game, statistics open (benchmark statistics true), Graph set to Gold

name: hud-timeline
what: The timeline window (F7) in the chronicle view with several entries

game.note: A replay at least 15 minutes in, timeline open (benchmark timeline true)

name: hud-replay-controls
what: The replay controls under the top bar: play, speeds, jump, Log, time and the bar with event ticks

game.note: A recording playing (benchmark replay), a few battles already on the bar

name: hud-replay-log
what: The replay's event log window with all four filters on

game.note: A recording playing, L pressed, Units filter switched on

name: hud-world-markers
what: On the battlefield: selected spearmen with health rings, a waypoint flag ahead of them, a building health bar

game.note: Several soldiers selected and sent to a point, a damaged building of the player's under the mouse

name: controls-box-select
what: A white selection box being dragged round a group of archers

game.note: Mid-drag with the left button; drawCursor on

name: controls-right-drag
what: A right-drag: the flag at the destination and the white facing line

game.note: Soldiers selected, right button held and dragged 4 m to one side of the flag; drawCursor on

name: controls-formation-line
what: Twelve spearmen in a Line formation wheeling into the dragged facing

game.note: 4 Peaks, a Line of 12 spearmen sent 20 m with a right-drag facing north, shot as they march in

name: controls-placement-valid
what: A barracks being placed: green preview, green footprint squares, its range ring

game.note: A peasant selected, placing a barracks on open ground next to the city (benchmark stampdown)
game.todo: scripted run gave an empty shot (diplomacy off in a default skirmish; stampdown preview not drawn at the mouse) - needs its own set-up

name: controls-placement-refused
what: A red building preview with the dark red Cannot build here box under the cursor

game.note: Placing a building on a steep slope or over another building; drawCursor on
